steps.en: Run the Silo container (or package) over your existing data directory
steps.zh: 用容器或软件包把 Silo 跑起来，数据目录沿用原来的

steps.en: Serves the S3 API on :9000 and the Silo Console on :9001
steps.zh: 在 :9000 提供 S3 API，在 :9001 提供 Web 控制台

steps.en: Point your existing S3 client or SDK at the endpoint, unchanged
steps.zh: 原有的 S3 客户端或 SDK 照旧指向这个端点

steps.en: Keep creating buckets and writing objects the way you did on MinIO
steps.zh: 像在 MinIO 上那样建桶、读写对象
steps.code: mcli mb local/demo · mcli ls local

steps.en: Stores objects in the unchanged MinIO layout — .minio.sys and erasure metadata included
steps.zh: 用不变的 MinIO 布局落盘：.minio.sys 与纠删码元数据都不动

steps.en: Keeps honoring MINIO_* env vars, x-minio-* headers and minio_* metrics
steps.zh: 继续认 MINIO_* 环境变量、x-minio-* 头与 minio_* 指标

value.en: A maintained S3 server with no data migration: your disks, config namespace and SDK clients carry over — only the delivery artifacts changed name
value.zh: 换到一个仍在维护的 S3 服务端，且不用迁数据：磁盘、配置命名空间和 SDK 客户端照旧，只有交付物改了名字

sources: https://github.com/pgsty/silo#quick-start (docker run pgsty/silo:latest server /data --console-address ":9001"; console on 9001, S3 API on 9000; mcli alias set / mcli mb / mcli ls)
https://github.com/pgsty/silo#compatibility (preserves S3 and storage-format compatibility: existing MINIO_* variables, minio_* metrics, x-minio-* headers, /minio/* routes and .minio.sys data)
https://silo.pgsty.com/compatibility/migration/ (reuses existing object data and volumes without an object-by-object export/import; Docker image replacement; MINIO_* unchanged)
